review_notes: I read all of Mixed.lean (lines 1–105). I also read the lemmas it uses in TensorPower.lean: orthogonalCupCapAt_tensorPowerBasis, orthogonalCupCapAt_comm and permTensorAction_mul_orthogonalCupCapAt. From Symmetric/TensorAction/Basic.lean I read permTensorAction_tensorPowerBasis, permTensorAction_apply and tensorPowerBasis_apply. The file declares only two relation theorems and no simp lemmas. Its proofs use `simp only` with explicit lemma lists and rewrite with `rw`. The related files already explain why the basis formulas are kept as explicit rewrites: `simp` would expand tensorPowerBasis through the simp lemma tensorPowerBasis_apply, and simpNF flags them as redundant. Making orthogonalCupCapAt_comm a simp lemma would risk a rewrite cycle. Making the two new relations simp lemmas would only be justified by looks. They have a hypothesis-heavy product form and no canonical normal form. The duplicated `hi`/`hj` involution facts in the second proof are a lemma-reuse matter, not a simp-interface defect. I found no concrete simp-interface problem, and I could not run Lean, so nothing here was checked experimentally.
